description: Effective Number of Codons (Wright 1990 Nc, CodonW enc_out conventions) for a coding sequence under an NCBI genetic code (genetic_code, default 1 = Standard): 20..61 under the standard code; when Nc cannot be calculated (a synonymous class other than the single 3-fold Ile class has no estimable amino acid; CodonW *****) enc = 0 and calculable = false. Optional method Novembre2002 (background-corrected Nc') or SunYangXia2013 (codonbias 0.5.0; always calculable with a sense codon) with pseudocount / background_correction / background; codonw_cap caps Wright Nc at CodonW's fixed 61.

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table number defining synonymous families and stops (default 1 = Standard).

method.description: Estimator: Wright1990 (CodonW enc_out), Novembre2002 or SunYangXia2013 (codonbias 0.5.0).

pseudocount.description: Novembre2002/SunYangXia2013 only: pseudocount per sense codon (>= 0; omitted = 0 / 1).

background_correction.description: Novembre2002/SunYangXia2013 only: background-composition expected codon frequencies (omitted = true / false).

background.description: With background correction only: sequence whose A/C/G/T composition is the background (omitted = the gene).

codonw_cap.description: Wright1990 only: cap at CodonW's fixed 61 instead of the code's sense-codon count.

enc.description: Effective Number of Codons, 20..61 (20 = extreme bias, 61 = no bias); 0 when not calculable (CodonW *****).

calculable.description: false when Nc cannot be calculated (CodonW *****); then enc = 0.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Unknown ENC method: X. Supported: Wright1990, Novembre2002, SunYangXia2013. / pseudocount, background_correction and background apply to the Novembre2002 and SunYangXia2013 methods only.
codonw_cap applies to the Wright1990 method only.
pseudocount must be a finite non-negative number (got X).
background must be a non-empty sequence and requires background correction.

input.sequence: TTTx4 TTC CTGx3 CTCx2 TTA ATTx3 ATCx2 ATA GTGx4 GTC AGCx3 TCTx2 TCA CGCx4 CGTx2 GGCx3 GGTx2 GGA (concatenated codons)

examples.name: Short gene with empty synonymous classes (CodonW: *****)

input.sequence: codon_i x ((7i mod 5)+1), all 64 codons in ACGT order
